parsed.note_claim: The owls came from the UK to Japan, where they died in 2021 after receiving the Japanese-made supplement; the labeling error was on the UK VIDEX product but the overdose occurred in Japan.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In 2021, 42 owls originating from the UK died after ingesting a Japanese-manufactured animal vitamin supplement. This product was modeled after the UK-made “MVS-30” by VIDEX Ltd. However, a labeling error on the original package listed “360gm” instead of the correct “360mg (milligrams).”
parsed.reason: The petition states the owls originated from the UK, died after ingesting a Japanese-made supplement, and that the VIDEX original label error was misread by the Japanese manufacturer, producing the 1000x overdose in Japan.
